description: We are The Space Maniacs, a multidisciplinary crew building an interactive Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer. Our platform puts young cadets in the pilot's seat through simulated mission scenarios, interactive problem-solving, and real-time feedback from an AI Mission Control companion. Our goal is to bridge the gap between textbook astronomy and hands-on astronaut training - making STEM accessible, immersive, and unforgettable for future explorers.
